fields.name: initial_loc
fields.comment: Initial Location

fields.name: data_loc
fields.comment: Data location

fields.name: digest_len
fields.comment: length of whirlpool digest blob (container begins at +0x08)

fields.name: file_count
fields.comment: HYPOTHESIS: group/file count. Used in WorkerOnMessage case 10 to size disk group-status array to (file_count+1)

fields.name: field_0x24
fields.comment: HYPOTHESIS: second per-archive u32 (highest group id or aux version)

fields.name: regionGridVec
fields.comment: EASTL vector begin ptr; dataArray stride 0x18 per region column, inner stride 0x18; cell+8 = RegionHeightContainer*

fields.name: readyA
fields.comment: +0x11: ready iff readyA==readyB. Outer container selects this sub via primary@+0x90 / fallback@+0xeba0; a sub is usable only when byte[+0x11]==byte[+0x12].

fields.name: notLoadedFlag
fields.comment: +0x159 on sub-container: !=0 => not loaded, height written as 0

fields.name: planeGridVecBegin
fields.comment: +0x160 sub: plane vec begin; end@+0x168; planeGrid=*(begin+8+plane*0x10); count=(end-begin)>>4

fields.name: linkHeightPlaneCount
fields.comment: +0x1d0 sub: plane count for the link-height-offset grid

fields.name: linkHeightGrid
fields.comment: +0x1d8 sub: int16 location/bridge height-offset grid. cell = base + plane*0x4000 + col*0x100 + row*4; col=fineX>>9,row=fineY>>9 tile 0..63; 2x int16/cell. SampleTileLinkHeightOffset reads it.

fields.name: plane0BridgeGrid
fields.comment: +0x1e8 sub: plane-0 BRIDGE vertex grid; used instead of normal plane-0 grid when usePlane0Bridge!=0. Same bilinear as planeGrid.

fields.name: def1
fields.comment: group-72 headbar def; def+0x8 = type id, def+0x44 fadeStart, def+0x48 lerpStep, def+0x4c removeAfter

fields.name: def2
fields.comment: second headbar def; NULL when type2 < 0

fields.name: startCycle
fields.comment: activation cycle = currentCycle + wireDelay; render elapsed = currentCycle - startCycle

fields.name: bar1FromFill
fields.comment: 0..255, tween start for def1

fields.name: bar1ToFill
fields.comment: 0..255, tween target for def1; displayed once elapsed >= transitionCycles

fields.name: transitionCycles
fields.comment: tween duration; expiry = startCycle + transitionCycles + def1[0x4c] < currentCycle

fields.name: highest_archive_id
fields.comment: = archiveCountByte - 1 (set from *param_1 in ctor)

fields.name: archive_count
fields.comment: number of archive entries = archive-count byte parsed from the 255/255 master-index blob. RequestGroupFromDisk crash: archiveId >= archive_count -> UD2 at 0xb61ad0

fields.name: entries
fields.comment: Js5MasterIndexEntry** : array[archive_count], indexed by archiveId

fields.name: onGamepadButton

fields.name: onGamepadTrigger
fields.comment: bool(uint joystickIndex, GamepadTrigger, uchar value) - axis>4 folded to value>>7

fields.name: perFrameUpdatables
fields.comment: eastl::rbtree anchor at +0x5E8, iteration starts at +0x5F0; Client::Main calls vtable+0x28 on *(node+0x20) after the SDL queue drains

fields.name: mouseY
fields.comment: 0x0168cbd4 - note Y precedes X in memory (verified on Linux and Windows builds)

fields.name: mouseX
fields.comment: 0x0168cbd8

fields.name: leftButtonDown
fields.comment: 0x0168cbdc - set 1 by OnLeftButtonDown, 0 by OnLeftButtonUp

fields.name: middleButtonDown
fields.comment: 0x0168cbdd - written only by the SDL pump (SDL_BUTTON_MIDDLE)

fields.name: rightButtonDown
fields.comment: 0x0168cbde - written by the SDL pump and by TouchLongPressToRightClick

fields.name: vptr
fields.comment: vtable 0x0141b930: +0x10 OnKeyDown +0x18 OnKeyUp +0x20 OnKeyChar

fields.name: globalHandler
fields.comment: Fallback handler; dispatched last, after every entry in namedHandlers

fields.name: mLock
fields.comment: pthread_mutex_t, __kind=1 (RECURSIVE) set inline by the Client ctor

fields.name: namedHandlers
fields.comment: eastl::rbtree<eastl::string, InputHandler*>; anchor at +0x40, iteration starts at +0x48, node value: string@+0x20 handler@+0x38

fields.name: lastMouseX
fields.comment: Written by OnMouseMotion; read by OnScrollWheel to build the wheel event position

fields.name: client
fields.comment: Owning jag::Client; this Input is embedded at Client+0x18D10

fields.name: consoleKeyHeld
fields.comment: Set by OnKeyDown(0x1ca3), cleared by OnKeyUp(0x1ca3); while set, OnKeyChar drops every codepoint

fields.name: mBegin
fields.comment: eastl::vector<std::function<bool(Args...)>*> begin

fields.name: mLock
fields.comment: pthread_mutex_t guarding the listener vector
